name: NAWC World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned in a lumberjack final at the promotion's own first pay-per-view, then changed hands twice more within the month.

name: NAWC Television Championship
epitaph: Won in a Royal Rumble on the promotion's second card, then taken in the ring from its own thief at the first pay-per-view.

name: NAWC Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Restarted after a disqualification finish so the promotion's own first titleholder could be crowned in the same match.

name: NAWC Lightweight Championship
epitaph: Opened the promotion's own Lightweight division in a six-man Last Man Standing match.
